domain: Climate Change and Drought Probability Modeling
scenario:
An international climate research organization seeks to develop a comprehensive data management and analytics platform to study the likelihood of severe droughts across various countries over several decades. The system will aggregate and analyze climate model data to predict drought probabilities, focusing on different climate models and statistical approaches.

The platform will store detailed data regarding annual severe drought likelihood predictions for a range of countries, using data from multiple climate models. Researchers will utilize this platform to identify trends, compare statistical methods, and assess the impact of climate change on drought occurrences. The system will also allow for cross-referencing of climate models and country-specific environmental data to provide insights into regional vulnerabilities.

To facilitate research collaboration and data analysis, the system must support dynamic querying capabilities, enable the comparison of different models and statistics, and provide detailed reports and visualizations. It will also offer role-based access to ensure secure data management, allowing researchers, data analysts, and policymakers to access relevant information according to their needs.
